resources.string: Type a city or pick one. Parley never uses your location.
Parley lists people whose address, notes or phone number match the city.
Nobody\'s address, notes or number mention it yet.
A SIM that isn\'t in this phone
Used for people in this label who don\'t have a SIM of their own.
Keep in touch when they join your circle
When you add someone from “%1$s” to your circle, Parley suggests this rhythm first.
Stars everyone here, so Android can let starred contacts ring
Let “%1$s” ring during Do Not Disturb?
A café, a conference, a friend\'s party
Saved as “Met at… on today\'s date” in their Circle timeline.
Also add it to their note
Swap: always show my card after receiving one
Your card is empty. Add your name and number to share it.
Couldn\'t export the notes. Check the folder and try again.
One .md file per person: their numbers, dates and labels, then your notes and the timeline. For Obsidian and other note apps. One way only: Parley writes the files and never reads them back.
Export again every hour, with folder sync
Parley needs access to contacts to export
The folder can\'t be opened any more. Pick it again.
Private contacts are never exported. Parley only changes the files it wrote; your own notes in the folder stay untouched.
One .md file per person with notes and timeline, to a folder you choose
markdown, md, obsidian, notes, logseq, export, folder, timeline
Big photo buttons for up to 9 people, a larger keypad and a question before declining. Set it up for someone else
elderly, senior, assisted, easy, large, big buttons, grandparent, accessibility, speak name

A calm home for someone who wants only the essentials: big photo buttons for the people who matter, a larger keypad, and a question before a call is declined. Set it up here, or on your phone and send it over.
A large keypad for other numbers
Large answer and decline buttons, and “Decline this call?” first
Speaks the caller\'s name while it rings. Uses the phone\'s text-to-speech; nothing is recorded
To leave simple mode, press and hold “Leave” at the top, then confirm (with the app lock, if it\'s on).
Save the setup as a file
Encrypted with a passphrase you choose. Contacts travel as names and numbers
Show the setup as a QR code
Scan it with the other phone\'s camera, then type the passcode
From a file made on another phone
Choose a passphrase of at least 8 characters. The other phone needs it to open the file.
Type the passphrase the setup was saved with.
Open the code with any QR scanner on the other phone; Parley opens and asks for this passcode.
Type the passcode shown on the other phone.
That didn\'t open it. Check the passcode or passphrase.
People who aren\'t in your contacts still get a button with their number. Create them to add a photo.
Use this setup and turn on simple mode
Leave simple mode to import a setup
Press and hold to leave simple mode
Parley goes back to its usual tabs. You can turn simple mode on again in Settings › Appearance.
No one here yet. Ask whoever set up this phone to add people in Settings › Appearance › Simple mode.

plurals.item: Parley stars %d person in this label. Starred contacts also show in Favourites and in other apps. Then, in Android\'s Do Not Disturb settings, allow calls from starred contacts: everyone starred can ring, not only this label.
